{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_2/brief/silicon_melting_2_trial_1/silicon_melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, K, bars)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production run at 2500K for MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset MSD to zero at start of production
reset_timestep  0
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Run production for sufficient time to calculate diffusion
# Using 500 ps for production run
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
dump            1 all custom 10000 trajectory.dump id type x y z
dump_modify     1 sort id

# Output MSD data for diffusion calculation
fix             msd_output all print 1000 "$(step) $(c_msd[4])" file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD"

run             500000  # 500 ps production
unfix           4
unfix           msd_output
undump          1

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_2/brief/silicon_melting_2_trial_1/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time = steps * 0.001  # in ps

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We need to fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 20% of data) and use the rest for fitting
skip_fraction = 0.2
start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)

# Perform linear fit on the linear region
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time[start_idx:], msd[start_idx:], 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2s = D * 1e-8

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Create a plot to visualize the fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time[start_idx:], coeffs[0]*time[start_idx:] + coeffs[1], 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nD = {D_m2s:.3e} m^2/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D: {D:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2s:.2e}")
"}
